findings: Delegates image layout; must inherit common range/scale/selection-distribution metadata from montage helper. No statistical marks locally.

purpose: Print RMSE/MAE/Durbin-Watson and show residual/QQ/scale-location diagnostic plots.
chart_type: residual, histogram, QQ and scale-location plots
findings: 15 by12 grid not square-axis constrained; opaque marks and raw third-party QQ styling; axes titles and QQ abbreviation. No 0.6 artist pass or common reference legend.

purpose: Fit a multiple-linear regression on gene:grna interactions plus plate/row/column terms.
findings: No direct marks in this lexical owner. Inherits the listed plot-helper findings; keep numerical/data processing unchanged while centralizing rendering.

purpose: Resize aligned image/label lists to ``target_height`` x ``target_width``.
findings: Only delegates image comparison; no local statistical graph or local style settings.

purpose: Post-process Cellpose masks: optional merge, size filter, intensity filter, border removal.
findings: Only delegates mask preview; image/outline rules belong to helper, not slot geometry.

purpose: Render a grid overlaying saliency maps on inputs with predicted-class labels.
findings: Explicit jet map violates no-rainbow rule; overlay alpha0.5; prediction labels inside images, no colourbar or scale reference; independent per-image stretch when enabled rather than matched comparison range.

purpose: Render a grid overlaying Grad-CAM maps on inputs with predicted-class labels.
findings: Explicit jet map; overlay alpha0.5; prediction labels in image; no colourbar/scale reference; optional per-image stretch. Shares duplicate rendering logic with saliency twin.

purpose: Synthesize an input image that maximizes the classifier score for ``target_y``.
findings: Calls pyplot directly, title has class and iteration count; no shared style context at image creation, no scale/key. This synthetic image is not a statistical chart or real representative sample.

purpose: Plot a 2-D embedding with cluster outlines, points, and optional image overlays.
findings: Default point_alpha0.65 and parallel theme helpers differ from shared authority; inherits cluster text and palette findings.

purpose: Return a deterministic Viridis RGBA palette for cluster points.
findings: Uses a continuous Viridis ramp for discrete cluster identities; black_background argument is unused. This bypasses the authority semantic roles and no-grey-control contract.

purpose: Resolve serializable GUI colors or the historical CLI fallback.
findings: Separate black/white/foreground/border policy duplicates shared style ownership; supports both themes but omits mark/font/geometry rules.

purpose: Apply one theme to a Matplotlib figure, axes, and axis lines.
findings: Styles chrome only; no mark-alpha, geometry, font minimum or reference-role enforcement. Consolidate through existing shared owner.

purpose: Create a square Matplotlib figure using scoped theme colors.
findings: Separate light/dark rc_context covers chrome but not full shared font/geometry/role rules; square canvas lacks square-axis enforcement. Should use existing shared style owner.

purpose: Draw cluster outlines, points, and centroid labels onto ``ax`` for a 2-D embedding.
findings: Default point alpha0.65; hull lines opaque; cluster IDs inside data area; fontsize int(figuresize*0.75) is7 at default10in; every point plotted; UMAP abbreviation unexpanded. No semantic reference-grey assignment.

purpose: Overlay sample images from ``image_paths`` on the UMAP embedding in ``ax``.
findings: Image-only delegate; randomly sampled thumbnails carry no statement of distribution position or common scale/range. Statistical alpha cannot be applied blindly to micrographs.

purpose: Overlay up to ``image_nr`` images per cluster on the embedding in ``ax``.
findings: Per-cluster random image selection without representative-distribution metadata; no local chart primitives beyond delegated image placement.

purpose: Place a zoomed thumbnail of ``img`` at ``(x, y)`` on ``ax``.
findings: Image renderer, not statistical point marks. No scale bar or shared display-range metadata; frameless thumbnail preserves caller sizing. Image opacity should not be conflated with chart mark opacity.

purpose: Plot a grid of example images per cluster label discovered in ``labels``.
findings: Delegates coloured image grid; inherits colour-key placement and fixed image-display contract findings.

purpose: Render one column per cluster of representative images with colored borders and labels.
chart_type: cluster image montage with colour key
findings: Colour key text is placed at figure x=1.05 outside nominal canvas; actual clipping depends on export bbox and needs render. Fixed user colours; matched swatch colour resolver is present. Image scale/range not enforced.

purpose: Cluster object morphology/intensity across a mask folder and keep the largest cluster in place.
findings: Numerical mask workflow delegates optional scatter; inherits local scatter title and geometry issues.

purpose: Show a 2-D PCA scatter of the property vectors colored by cluster label.
findings: Direct pyplot without shared style context; opaque viridis-coded dots; title inside figure; PCA abbreviation unexpanded; square axes and reference metadata absent.

purpose: Draw and optionally export a customizable volcano plot.
